name: Super Bock Group
note: Portuguese brewer, privately held; 56% held by holding VIACER (itself 71.5% Violas group / 28.5% Carlsberg) and 44% directly by Carlsberg (per pt.wikipedia Super Bock Group corporate structure). Largest single owner group is the Portuguese Violas family; Carlsberg (Denmark) holds a large economic interest. No state link.
